transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Tuesday, October 20. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Asian Para Games: Bhavina Patel wins bronze in table tennis. Bhavina Patel won a bronze medal in the women's singles Class 4-5 table tennis event at the Asian Para Games 2026. She lost in the semi-finals to Zhang Bian of China, finishing her singles campaign. Previously, Bhavina was the flag bearer for India at these Games. Her notable achievements include winning silver at the Tokyo Paralympics and gold at the Commonwealth Games. After ditching Mamata Banerjee, Yusuf Pathan gets a gift from Gujarat govt. The state government approved the allotment of a disputed 978 sqm plot in Vadodara to Yusuf Pathan. The allotment includes 500 sqm for residential use and 478 sqm at a reduced rate. This decision follows a long-standing dispute over the plot, which began in 2012 with Pathan's initial request. The municipal commissioner noted that final details must still undergo approval by the VMC's standing committee. Residents fight California AI data centre; judge demands environmental review. A judge in California has ordered an extensive environmental review for an AI data center proposed in Imperial County. Concerns among local residents center on water resource impacts, emissions, and community disturbances. Developer Sebastian Rucci claims the project will generate jobs and tax income while enhancing AI infrastructure. However, legal disputes persist from the City of Imperial and environmental advocates challenging its progression. Sold house, bought rupees 1.10 cr flat with wife; I-T dept rejects exemption for half amount. A man sold his residential property and invested the proceeds in another flat in Mumbai. The replacement property was jointly registered in his and his wife's names, with the total investment of around rupees 1.10 crore. He claimed exemption on the capital gains under Section 54 of the Income Tax Act. Dussehra messages, greetings, wishes and quotes for 2026. Dussehra, occurring on October 20, 2026, celebrates the triumph of good over evil. This vibrant festival features heartfelt prayers, joyful family reunions, and the dramatic burning of effigies. It serves as a time for reconciliation, encouraging individuals to leave past grievances behind while embracing fresh starts. Messages of goodwill are shared, fostering positivity and strengthening connections, reminding everyone to embody love and bravery in everyday life. Inside Lawrence Bishnoi gang's 'shadow cabinet': 5 key aides running global operations. Who really controls the Lawrence Bishnoi network while its notorious kingpin is confined to a high-security cell inside Gujarat's Sabarmati jail? 'Deliberately breached bonds': Why court extended Das, Ranka's custody by two days. A special executive magistrate (SEM) on Monday extended the judicial custody of Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) activists Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka by two days, rejecting fresh sureties furnished by their counsel. 14 killed, 7 injured in illegal gold mine collapse in Colombia. Fourteen people were killed and seven others injured after an illegal gold mine collapsed in southwestern Colombia, local authorities said on Monday. 1848 Massachusetts mill gets $53M revival as 86 apartments, 69 affordable. Once a 170-year-old stone mill, the Lawrence, Massachusetts landmark has been revitalized with a $53 million restoration, now offering 86 residential units, 69 of them affordable housing options. Among these, 58 are tailored for low-income individuals and 11 designed for those in very low-income brackets. Flood prevention measures include ground floor elevation, and the building incorporates energy-efficient features. Welsh care deputy took £400k from 99-year-old for surgery, car; struck off. UK nurse Rebecca Louise Burwood has been struck off the nursing register after an NMC tribunal found she abused her position of trust involving a vulnerable 99-year-old care home resident. More than £370,000 was withdrawn from the woman's account over five years. The hearing also examined spending on a car, motorhome and alleged cosmetic surgery. Steve Ballmer gave $10mn to restore LA courts; 350 projects completed 4 years later. Steve Ballmer and his wife, Connie Ballmer, donated $10 million to renovate basketball courts in Los Angeles. The project successfully revamped 350 courts throughout the city, making them more accessible. The Clippers Community Courts project was completed on June 28, 2022, at the Michelle and Barack Obama Sports Center. The renovated courts have served multi-purpose functions during the Covid-19 pandemic, aiding the community.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Dussehra Bank holiday today: Are banks open or closed in your state today (October 20, 2026)?. Bank holiday today: On October 20, 2026, banks in many Indian states will be closed for Dussehra and other festivals. Meanwhile, Sikkim and Manipur will have banks open on that day. AT-1 bonds back in news after Yes Bank case: Why banks issue them, how investors earn returns Don'ts to avoid losses. The Supreme Court upheld the Bombay High Court's decision to quash Yes Bank's 2020 write-off of rupees 8,415 crore in AT-1 bonds. Here's all you need to know about AT-1 bonds. From 100 million users in 170 days to an IPO, a decade of Jio Platforms. Jio Platforms is on the brink of its initial public offering, an important step in its evolution. Since its inception in 2016, the company has gained over 524 million customers and achieved impressive profitability. With significant investments from leading global players in recent years and a vast portfolio of patents, Jio is positioning itself as a leader in innovation. 1 Finance gets in-principle SEBI approval for MF Lite: Will investors get more choice in index funds and ETFs?. 1 Finance has received in-principle SEBI approval for an MF Lite licence and plans to launch passive mutual funds in Q4 FY27. SEBI's framework eases regulatory requirements for eligible passive fund houses, potentially encouraging competition and expanding investor choice in index funds and ETFs. 96 IPOs raise rupees 1.1 lakh crore in 2026 even as the Nifty corrects. India's equity market in 2026 shows pressure in the secondary market with significant foreign outflows affecting benchmarks. The Nifty 50 index is reportedly in correction territory after a series of losses. In contrast, the primary market remains active, with numerous IPOs successfully raising substantial capital. Domestic liquidity supports fundraising despite investor selectivity regarding valuations and corporate governance. Home loan borrowers: Pay higher EMI every month or extend your loan tenure? How to choose after a rate hike. A rise in home loan rates forces borrowers to choose between higher EMIs and longer repayment tenures. A rupees 50 lakh loan example shows how a 25-basis-point increase affects monthly payments and total interest, and what borrowers should consider before deciding. NPS Central launched: Subscribers can now access CRA, pension fund and PoP services at single perform. The Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority has rolled out NPS Central, a transformative digital platform designed for hassle-free management of National Pension System accounts. Gold and silver investments: Should you buy physical gold, ETFs or mutual funds? Liquidity, costs and risks compared. Investors can choose from physical gold and silver, digital gold, ETFs, mutual funds, Sovereign Gold Bonds and Electronic Gold Receipts. Each option differs in costs, liquidity, regulation, taxation and storage needs, making it important to compare the risks before investing. Salary up to rupees 25,000: EPFO reveals how you can enrol for EPF, EPS and ELDI schemes. The government recently raised the wage ceiling for the Employees' Provident Fund to rupees 25,000, allowing a broader range of workers to access the EPF, EPS, and EDLI schemes. This increase means that employees earning up to the new limit can secure essential social security benefits. Bitcoin investor faces rupees 88.55 lakh tax addition despite rupees 3.34 lakh loss; how an ITAT ruling helped the investor. A Bitcoin investor who reported a rupees 3.34 lakh loss faced an rupees 88.55 lakh tax addition over the source of funds. ITAT quashed the reassessment after the tax officer ignored his reply and failed to provide the minimum response time required by law. 8th Pay Commission: Level 1 salary at rupees 47,160, rupees 54,000 or rupees 69,000? Check Level 1-5 estimates at different fitment factors. 8th Pay Commission latest news: On October 22-23, 2026, Mumbai will host consultation meetings for the 8th Pay Commission, where employee and pensioner associations will strongly advocate for enhanced fitment factors relative to previous standards. The agenda includes vital discussions on salary adjustments, pension increases, and allowances for government employees. Proposed factors range from 2.62 to 4.38, with 3.833 being widely favored, pending the government's budgetary framework. Google Review scam: Over 20 people reportedly lose rupees 1 crore in a month; 5 warning signs to watch out for. More than 20 people in Visakhapatnam reportedly lost rupees 1 crore in a month to a Google Review job scam. Fraudsters used small initial payouts to build trust before demanding larger deposits, leaving victims unable to withdraw their money. DA hike news: Will central govt employees get a 3 percent DA hike on October 21?. Central government employees were expecting a dearness allowance (DA) hike announcement after the Cabinet meeting on October 14. However, the government announced a performance-linked bonus for Railway employees without announcing the much-awaited DA hike. 8th Pay Commission fitment factor: Higher basic pay or more allowances, what is better for govt employees?. Fitment factor demands range from 3.2 to 4 or higher as central government employees await a revised salary structure. PFRDA launches NPS Central: How simplified pension portal works, who can use, how to log in Top features explained. PFRDA has launched NPS Central, a digital platform where subscribers can enrol, manage accounts, review investments and make contributions. Details here. Renting a house in UP? New tenancy rules aim to protect both tenants and landlords; know what changes. Uttar Pradesh is set to introduce revamped tenancy regulations designed to streamline the rental agreement process for landlords and tenants alike. This initiative includes lower stamp duty and registration fees to encourage formalized agreements instead of informal arrangements. With enhanced legal protections and clearer proof of residence for tenants, landlords will also gain improved documentation options. These reforms aim to lessen disputes and foster a more equitable rental market. Home loan prepayment versus SIP: Which is a better option and saves you more money? Here's the maths. With home loan EMIs spread over a 20-25-year tenure, even small payments in the initial years can significantly reduce overall interest outgoings over time. NRI tax return: can you correct a wrongly claimed capital gains exemption in your ITR?. An NRI living in the UAE mistakenly claimed treaty relief on gains from Indian shares and mutual funds. While the revised-return deadline has passed, an updated return may offer a way to correct the error. PM-VBRY: Financial literacy course must for new EPFO members to get rupees 15,000 incentive, eligibility, how to claim it.
